subject: russian
core_rule: Routing metadata is additive and external to current trainer cards. It must never require changing trainer_item_id, answers, scoring, prompt text or production storage.

fields.trainer_item_id: existing stable trainer item ID; never generated anew for an existing card
fields.routing_precision: item | option | position | word | match_position | task | expert_self_check
fields.candidate_subskill_ids: Skill Graph IDs potentially checked by the item
fields.exact_subskill_id: optional; allowed only when the item/result position isolates one accepted Skill Graph subskill
fields.explanation_id: optional exact explanation unit selected by the tag
fields.option_tags: optional array for independently diagnosable answer options
fields.word_tags: optional array for independently tagged words/forms
fields.match_tags: optional A/B/C/D/E mapping positions for matching tasks

fields.position_id: stable within trainer_item_id, e.g. pos_1 or match_A; do not depend on visual DOM index alone
fields.subskill_ids: accepted Skill Graph IDs checked at this position
fields.explanation_id: optional exact learner explanation for this position

4.purpose: exact normative stress form and POS cluster

7.purpose: noun vs numeral vs verb-form diagnosis

8.purpose: exact syntax error explanation; total score is insufficient

9.purpose: root rule family; total set is mixed

10.purpose: prefix rule family; total set is mixed

11.purpose: select one of task-11 internal explanation splits

14.purpose: select one of five task-14 internal explanation splits

18.purpose: introductory word vs address vs non-introductory homonym

21.purpose: exact rule family, not merely sign name

22.purpose: exact expressive-device diagnosis; total matching score is insufficient

25.purpose: current phraseologism vs legacy contextual synonym

26.purpose: avoid inferring which cohesion means failed from all-or-nothing result

27.purpose: expert/self-check only; no normal correct-answer routing

validation_rules: trainer_item_id must exist in current repository-visible trainer snapshot or accepted trainer item map
all skill/subskill links must exist in accepted Skill Graph
exact_subskill_id requires diagnostic evidence at the declared precision
legacy task-25 synonym item must remain legacy and separate from current phraseologism route
no routing tag may modify or override the stored correct answer
a tag marked reviewed may be used for learner feedback; draft/needs_review may not drive exact production feedback
